This looks great. The saved item is exactly what I was hoping for — I can see the title "The surprising intelligence of octopuses," a short description, the source, when I saved it, and a preview image. That's a world away from staring at a bare web address. It feels recognizable and useful.

And yes, the one-field-and-a-button approach feels right — paste, click, done. That's the effortless part I wanted.

One thing I'll want when we get to it: if the app got a detail wrong, I'd like to fix the title or description myself. But no need to change anything now — this is the right foundation.
